QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: SwathWidth
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Effective spray width of one pass. Passes are spaced this far apart.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: PassAngle
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Direction the passes run, in degrees clockwise from north.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: PassOffset
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Slides the passes sideways, at 90 degrees to the pass angle (+ is to the right of the pass direction). The passes are refitted inside the buffer.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: Altitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Spray height above the takeoff point.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: ApplicationRate
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Target application rate, sent to the onboard spray app.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: EdgeMargin
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Buffer kept inside the field boundary on every side without its own buffer. Nothing is sprayed in this strip. At least 3 ft.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: TransitMode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: How the drone gets from takeoff to the field and back. A: straight to the entry side of the field. B: along a planned route.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: TransitAltitude
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Height above ground for flying to and from the field.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: TransitSpeed
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Ground speed for flying to and from the field.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: HeadlandPass
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Fly one pass around the edge of the spray area after the straight passes.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: TankCapacity
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Liquid the drone's tank holds when full. Used to estimate the trips a job takes. Saved for all jobs.

QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: BatteryMinutes
QGC.MetaData.Facts.shortDesc: Flight time on one battery with a full tank, until the drone should head home (keep your reserve out of it). Used to estimate the trips a job takes. Saved for all jobs.
